scientific_question: Can the two capacity-passing reserved-escape layouts preserve the loss-closing FP16 Muon history bit-exactly with at least 20% exact-config MFU?

implementation_contract.reserved_escape: the all-ones fixed-width code means that the exact high byte is read from the block exception stream
implementation_contract.primary_dictionary: K-1 most frequent high bytes per 4096-word block, with count ties broken by ascending uint8
implementation_contract.control_dictionary: K-1 most frequent high bytes per c_fc/c_proj scope, with count ties broken by ascending uint8
implementation_contract.state_ownership: The checkpoint and live optimizer state persist only packed low bytes, packed codes, dictionaries, exception literals, offsets, and descriptors; a second dense FP16 or FP32 momentum owner is forbidden.
implementation_contract.causality: At each update the encoded state is decoded exactly, updated in FP16 with the already sealed owner recurrence, and the new exact FP16 word field is encoded with tables derived only from that current field.
implementation_contract.transient_policy: A transient decoded/new FP16 field is allowed only during the optimizer update and must be released before the next forward pass. Peak allocated memory is measured.
implementation_contract.loss_endpoint: forbidden because a bit-exact state transition makes it scientifically redundant

phases.name: standalone_checkpoint_codec
requirements: random binary16 words and all special values round-trip bit-exactly
the frozen checkpoint reconstructs word-stream SHA-256 407c142e7e4098d3c3972d6b3b772fa7f913e0a057eec84181821ab07b1ea3e0
observed persistent momentum bytes remain at or below 99090432
encode plus decode wall time for all 24 MLP matrices is at most 250 ms on PRO6 GPU0 after warmup
no CPU entropy codec or host transfer occurs in the timed region

phases.name: optimizer_identity_and_resume
phases.entry_gate: standalone candidate passes every phase-one requirement
requirements: one-step parameters, momentum words, polar requests, and loss equal the FP16 ambient owner bit-for-bit
save/load produces identical packed state and identical next-step result
nine consecutive optimizer updates preserve exact identity
there is no hidden dense persistent momentum owner

phases.name: exact_config_mfu_gate
phases.configuration: the sealed 124M Pair-VQ FP16-ambient endpoint configuration with only the state representation changed
requirements: at least 9 timed training updates after warmup
report tokens/s, iteration time, optimizer fraction, GPU utilization, peak allocation, exact persistent bytes, and transient decoded bytes

selection_rule.if_both_pass: Choose the higher-MFU implementation; choose the smaller block-local primary only if MFU differs by less than one absolute point.
selection_rule.if_neither_passes: Reject the registered GPU table-code family and retain the sealed FP16 ambient-momentum owner as the measured training-state floor.
selection_rule.post_selection: Seal implementation and systems results. Do not run a language-model loss endpoint, horizon transfer, scale-up, or sweep.

execution_policy.code_transfer: commit locally and pull the exact Git commit on PRO6; ad-hoc source copying is forbidden
execution_policy.performance_monitoring: foreground-poll standalone and nine-step gates expected below five minutes; if any phase exceeds five minutes, attach a terminal/error-only @Codex watchdog immediately
execution_policy.resource: PRO6 GPU0 only after a pinned-driver NVML health check and idle-card verification
